stages.body: Complete all five chapters and the story missions. Every story trophy unlocks automatically and none can be missed. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter. Do optional missions as they appear, and scan vehicles and study animals with the WAiNK app and binoculars from the beginning — you will need 200 base-model vehicles and 100 animals studied for 100%.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 5
stages.warning: MISSABLE — in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning. When she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. Do it before leaving Chapter 1.

stages.body: Finish the five named character strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — and every other stranger strand you find, until 8 strands are complete. Only some questlines count toward the 8, so finish them all and watch the trophy's counter. Hunt Bret's unique animal and work through his 15 Target Deck objectives.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and side strands

stages.body: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations (plus all 42 drone time trials for 100%), win 30 of 40 races, land 300 stunts, complete 70 of 80 challenges, beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, and meditate at the remaining 17 spots. Try all 9 activity types for Master of None.
stages.title: Activities, races and challenges

stages.body: Rob all 8 bank vaults (they unlock with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…), rob an armored truck, rob a jewelry store without being detected, chain 3 shop robberies with your partner, rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs, lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, and take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. Steal the departing jet at VCIA and a Rhino tank, and launder $250,000 of marked bills.
stages.title: Crime with your partner

stages.body: Complete 15 of 18 card sets, WAiNK 100 locations, discover 200 base-model vehicles, explore all 52 areas of Leonida, buy all 8 garage properties, register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, and spend $100,000 across shops. Sweep the map region by region in free roam.
stages.title: Collectibles, exploring and money
stages.trophies: Don't Touch My Deck (Silver), You WAiNKer! (Silver) + 5 more

stages.body: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and clear whatever the checklist still shows: 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs, 50 of 91 stick ups, fencing targets, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 50 of 66 weapons, and the rest. When A Long Road pops, check the list once more — the platinum follows as soon as the last trophy lands.
stages.title: 100% completion — A Long Road, then the platinum
stages.trophies: A Long Road (Gold), then Vice Got a Price! (Platinum)

summary: One playthrough, no online trophies, no difficulty trophies, about 200 hours. Play the story first, protect the one missable meditation in Chapter 1, then clear 100% completion, then the stranger strands and cleanup. Cheats disable trophies and saving while active, and there is no mission replay — keep manual saves (15 slots).
title: Roadmap to the platinum — Vice Got a Price!
